programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Engineering Earth"
programme.desc: A heroic bid for freedom by an enslaved couple in 19th century America precipitates great innovation that culminates in people literally making heavens open. But can controlling the weather save us from climate catastrophe? Or are we playing god?

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Where Are All the Aliens?"
programme.desc: We’re looking hard, but the numbers aren’t stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Star Light, Star Bright"
programme.desc: The two current science missions to our star; the sun have made great leaps forward in the science of how stars work, how they generate solar winds and how they affect their orbiting planets. This lets us look at other stars with great understanding.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Moon Shine"
programme.desc: The International drive to return to the Moon is gathering pace. We look at what resources scientists and engineers are looking to extract from Lunar regolith and Martian soil.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Rising Tides"
programme.desc: The next generation of Earth observation satellites are now in place maintaining the continuity of long-term climate data. Scientists are concerned the rate is increasing beyond expectations and glacier melting continues unabated.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Private Space Companies"
programme.desc: As NASA prepares to send astronauts to the moon, private space companies are becoming more involved with missions in low-earth orbit. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at SpaceX, a private company that has exceeded expectations.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Extremes"
programme.desc: Did you know that the coldest place in our solar system is an area on our moon? Host Emily Calandrelli takes a look at the planets and moons in our solar system that are extremely inhospitable.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Next Robot on Mars"
programme.desc: Emily Calandrelli looks at the history of robots that NASA has sent to Mars, including the very first rover, Sojourner. In 2020, NASA launched the most sophisticated rover yet, Perseverance, which will uncover many more mysteries of the Red Planet.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S7 - "UFOs: What's Really Out There?"
programme.desc: Is there proof that aliens are visiting our planet? What is behind these UFO sightings? Host Emily Calandrelli searches for the truth by interviewing experts and visiting Roswell, New Mexico, the site where some believe aliens once landed.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Training - P-51"
programme.desc: Kurtis takes you back in time to see what it was like for young WWII pilots fly in the legendary fighter, the P-51 Mustang.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Winter Flying"
programme.desc: Anthony shows us the different methods to keep yourself and your plane warmed up in those cold winter months.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Night Time Flying"
programme.desc: Kurtis and Anthony take us night flying. Some say it's more beautiful... while others think it's more dangerous!

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Guardian Angels"
programme.desc: Experiencing an aviation emergency where the calm voice on the other end of the radio helps get our pilot out of trouble.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Fusion: Harnessing the Power of Stars"
programme.desc: Humanity is closer than ever before to a perpetual clean power source after a team of scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory successfully produced a nuclear fusion reaction resulting in a net energy gain.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "The Great Seaweed Invasion"
programme.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean! At sea, the sargassum belt is a floating ecosystem, but when it hits shore it turns toxic.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "ECHO: The Penguin's Bodyguard"
programme.desc: In Antarctica, ECHO - a state-of-the-art robotic penguin - uses remote sensing technology to monitor these now-endangered penguin colonies.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Growing Up Hadzabe"
programme.desc: Our earliest ancestors, before developing agriculture as a source of food, formed what is considered hunter-gather societies. The Hadzabe of Tanzania are considered one of the last of these tribes on the planet.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Tastes Like T-Rex"
programme.desc: Modern birds are the most direct descendants of some of the most iconic dinosaurs to ever walk on this planet. Bue can science really enable us to alter chicken embryos to resemble their mightiest ancestor: T-Rex?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Antarctica Science Below Zero"
programme.desc: Antarctica is a mysterious and unexplored continent. Thanks to the Chilean Antarctic Institute and the research center Dynamics of Marine Ecosystems of High Altitudes, scientists are suffering the extreme temperatures to study climate change.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Last American Slave Ship"
programme.desc: The final ship to bring slaves to the United States has been hidden in the swamps of Mobile, Alabama for generations.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "George Aldrich"
programme.desc: Thom meets a man with a superhuman sense of smell; George Aldrich is Nasa’s Chief Sniffer; employed to detect problems before they become a hazard in space.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Feeding The Billions"
programme.desc: We explore potential new strategies to satisfy the growing food demand, from restaurants growing potatoes in the air to jellyfish as a potential sustainable meat alternative.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "The People's Voice"
programme.desc: We meet grassroots movements in US and UK who are fighting for a political intervention to stop climate change.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Plastic Into Products"
programme.desc: We meet enviro-entrepreneurs who recycle plastic waste to produce a large variety of items from fishing boats to coffee cups.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Rewilding Patagonia"
programme.desc: We visit Patagonia National Park to find out how it became one of the biggest conservation projects in history.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Iceland"
programme.desc: Northern Iceland has many of the wild features that we love – volcanoes, glaciers, avalanches, mudslides, big waves, and extreme marine weather. All that – plus weird red and green lights dancing around in the winter sky!

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Hurricane Triple Threat"
programme.desc: Early September of 2008 saw radical imagery on the hurricane maps of the Atlantic – four named tropical storms, swirling in a train across the ocean. “Angry Planet” was there as three of them made landfall as hurricanes in the US.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Elephant Cave"
programme.desc: Possibly the home of the deadly Marberg Ebola virus, Kitum Cave is high on Mt.Elgon straddling the Kenya-Uganda border. When host George Kourounis gets bitten by one of the bats…well, you’ll have to see the show to find out what happens.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Eco-Disasters"
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Flame Thower"
programme.desc: A thousand years old Chinese flamethrower, will it be a real weapon or just a kitchen tool for flaming.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Tank"
programme.desc: Hand powered tank, is that possible? Leonardo Da Vinci thought so. Today we will test this theory.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Chariot"
programme.desc: Today we have Leonardo Da Vinci's invention again. Could this death chariot change warfare?

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hitler's Last Secret"

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Mussolini's Underground Refuge"
programme.desc: 50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
programme.desc: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "82nd Airborne"
programme.desc: Paratroopers are elite troops, tougher and faster than foot soldiers. We join the 82nd Airborne training for high-risk, behind-enemy-lines missions.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Navy Divers"
programme.desc: Ship divers tackle dangerous missions at sea, from clearing nets and mines to rescuing lives. We explore their intense training and high-stakes work.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Trauma Care"
programme.desc: Combat Casualty Care trains soldiers to save lives on the battlefield, ensuring rapid response to injuries from IEDs and other deadly threats.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac"
programme.desc: What starts off as a seven-pound bar of solid steel will soon deliver a bullet with deadly accuracy when it becomes the barrel of a Colt C7 assault rifle, and when plastic and bulletproof fabric are molded and stitched together,they’ll make a suit of armour made for the most dangerous job in the world.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter"
programme.desc: As lightweight aluminum is cut and tooled, it will become the frame of a personal flying machine. Used by military operatives, drug enforcement agents, and first responders – it gets you in and out fast, whether you are carrying a camera or a gun.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Lucas Toledo"
programme.desc: After yet another public transport strike in their hometown Cordoba, Argentina, Lucas Toledo and two of his friends decided to design a foldable electric bike.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Tabb Firchau"

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Shane Chen"
programme.desc: Shane Chen is an inventor. Or to use his own words, he is a “tinkerer” – a fellow who makes a living from molding mechanisms into quirky creations.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Stripped"

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Dyno Test"

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Meet the Press"
programme.desc: The official press launch of The Flying Kestrel at legendary racetrack, Santa Pod. The Kestrel team is joined by Victor Riley of Riley Cars, and celebrity Rachel Riley.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "RoboGal (AKA Queen of Robots)"
programme.desc: One of the world’s leading tech developers is creating a new generation of robots designed to help people with everyday tasks.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programme.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes"
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences"
programme.desc: Theaters and opera houses are wonders of stage technology, as well as exquisite masterpieces of modern or historic architecture.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Trains"

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Strike Planes"
programme.desc: Take a look at the history of creating stronger, faster and more powerful military aircraft.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Algoma Bulk Freighter"

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Pacific Orca"
programme.desc: A unique wind-turbine installation ship lifts its hull out of the water while facing violent seas and high winds.

programme.desc: Paintball gun, floor scrubber, ice machine, pool table, shopping trolley, gas boiler... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.desc: Car winch, hiking boot, coffee machine, piano, vending machine, abseil catch... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs"
programme.desc: Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector, and multi-tool... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Treadmills, Turntables and Barbeques"
programme.desc: Treadmill, turntable, barbeque, outboard motor, pneumatic drill, ballpoint pen... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Earths Evil Twin"
programme.desc: Venus once may have been as hospitable to life as Earth is now. Then something changed and Venus became shrouded in hot dense toxic clouds. There are now plans to send advanced probes to the surface of Venus and find out what happened to our twin.

programme.desc: The ISS is the workhorse of the international spacefaring community, but its days are numbered. Replacement space stations are on the drawing board. However, with commercial interests these stations will add tourism and manufacturing to the mix.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Mountains In The Dark"
programme.desc: Asteroids, the debris from the early solar system hold tantalizing clues to planetary formation. The spacecraft Psyche readies to study a unique metallic asteroid. As Lucy is on its way to the trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Oceans in the Sky"
programme.desc: Juice and the Europa Clipper are two missions to our Solar System’s largest planet. They will spend over four years studying Jupiter’s atmosphere, magnetosphere and in particular its icy moons, investigating if they hold oceans suitable for life.

programme.desc: How do they forge one of the greatest inventions of all time, the axe? How do they cut, sew, stitch and glue together a courier’s messenger bag? How do they build the world’s fastest lifeboats?

programme.desc: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Tesla/Horse Hair Fabrics/Pool Cleaners"
programme.desc: How do they build the world’s fastest electric car? How do they turn horses’ tails into fine fabrics? How do they clean the world’s largest swimming pools?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Snails/Cutlery/Fishing Kayaks"
programme.desc: How do they feed France’s appetite for snails? How do they turn slabs of steel into shiny cutlery? How do they craft a kayak you can paddle with your feet?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Emergency Bridges/Marker Pens/Electric superbike"
programme.desc: How do they build emergency bridges that can take the weight of a tank? How do they make a marker pen that never fades? How do they design a 200 mph superbike?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Crystal Glass/Flat Screen TVs/Deepest Pool/Ketchup"
programme.desc: How do they blow the world’s finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world’s slimmest TVs? How do they heat the world’s deepest swimming pool? How do they fill a million bottles a day of the world’s favourite ketchup?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Pulverizer/Bomber Jackets/Lambic Beer/"
programme.desc: How do they forge a set of jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks? How do they stitch the historic airman’s bomber? How do they brew the oldest beer in the Western World?

programme.desc: How do they cool Sydney’s famous Opera House? How do they turn Sheffield steel into a carpenter’s handsaw? How do they make a microphone that can pick up a whisper? How do they steer a safe course through a frozen river?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Moonshine/e-bikes/Wetsuits"
programme.desc: How do they brew moonshine in the heart of New York City? How do they make a battery powered bicycle that can do nearly 30mph? How do they grow the rubber for wetsuits in the Arizona desert?
